name: ProofWriter
description: A benchmark for evaluating multi-step deductive reasoning by generating proofs over sets of facts and rules written in natural language. Problems require chains of logical inference to reach conclusions, with depth levels from 0 to 5 inference steps.
reputation: Important benchmark for logical/deductive reasoning; used to test chain-of-thought reasoning; introduced reasoning depth as a variable
notes: Tests closed-world deductive reasoning with facts like 'All cats are mammals'. Depth-5 problems require 5 inference steps. Largely saturated by current large models.
